title: Module 10 Interpretation Check
intro: Each item gives you a short research situation. Decide what the evidence supports.

items.q: Three groups of 10 have means 10, 12, and 15, and SS within = 270. What is MS within?
items.why: df within = 30 minus 3 = 27, so MS within = 270/27 = 10.

items.q: SS between for those groups is 126.67. What is MS between?
items.why: df between = 3 minus 1 = 2, so MS between = 126.67/2 = 63.33.

items.q: What is F, and is it significant at alpha = .05?
o: F = 6.33 with df (2, 27). It exceeds the critical value of 3.35, so yes
F = 6.33, but it is not significant
items.why: F = 63.33/10 = 6.33. The critical F(2, 27) at .05 is 3.354. The exact p is about .006.
SS total = 126.67 + 270 = 396.67, so eta squared = 126.67/396.67 = .319, a large effect by common benchmarks.

items.q: After a significant F, the researcher says "all three groups differ." What should be done?
o: Run a post hoc test to see which pairs differ
Use three independent t tests at .05
items.why: The omnibus test is silent about which pairs differ.
